class.name: ChorusRequest
class.description: Generation input for [method GodotChorus.generate], [method GodotChorus.regenerate] or [method GodotChorus.render_prompt]. Use [method ChorusRequest.chat] for a conversation or [method ChorusRequest.stateless] for a raw prompt. Assigning an optional generation property selects it, even when assigning zero, [code]false[/code] or an empty array. A matching [code]has_*()[/code] method reports whether it is selected; [code]clear_*()[/code] removes only this request's choice. Unselected Inspector values are display values, not effective defaults. Request choices override project-wide generation settings, which override provider defaults. Providers honor selected options or reject them; they do not silently ignore unsupported choices. Admission freezes the values and history used for this request. You may reuse or change the resource afterward without changing accepted work. [codeblock] var request = ChorusRequest.chat(&"innkeeper", "What happened here?") request.max_tokens = 128 request.stream = true var submission = chorus.generate(request) if not submission.accepted: push_error(submission.message) [/codeblock]

method.name: chat
method.description: Creates a new chat-turn request. The session must be nonempty when submitted. The content becomes a user message in that conversation. Submit with [method GodotChorus.generate]; this factory alone starts no work.

method.name: stateless
method.description: Creates a request with no session. The content is a raw prompt, without conversation history or chat-template rendering. Submit with [method GodotChorus.generate].

method.name: regeneration
method.description: Creates an empty-content request for replacing the latest assistant reply in a nonempty session. Submit with [method GodotChorus.regenerate], not [method GodotChorus.generate].

method.name: has_max_tokens
method.description: Returns whether [member ChorusRequest.max_tokens] is explicitly selected on this resource. It does not inspect project or provider defaults.

method.name: clear_max_tokens
method.description: Removes the request-level [member ChorusRequest.max_tokens] choice so later submissions inherit project or provider defaults. The displayed value is not reset and is no longer selected.

method.name: set_constraint
method.description: Selects an output constraint using the supplied format and source, overriding inherited constraints. Unsupported formats or invalid sources fail validation. See [enum ChorusConstraintFormat.Value].

method.name: set_unconstrained
method.description: Explicitly disables any inherited output constraint for this request. Unlike [method ChorusRequest.clear_constraint], this selects an override.

method.name: has_constraint
method.description: Returns whether a constraint choice is selected on this resource, including explicit unconstrained output. It does not inspect inherited defaults.

method.name: is_unconstrained
method.description: Returns whether this resource explicitly disables output constraints. False does not imply that an inherited constraint exists.

method.name: clear_constraint
method.description: Removes the request-level constraint choice, including explicit unconstrained output, restoring inheritance from project or provider defaults.

method.name: clear_provider_options
method.description: Removes all request-level provider choices. Project-level provider choices remain eligible for inheritance.

method.name: clear_provider_option
method.description: Removes one request-level key from the named provider namespace. Missing keys are ignored. A matching project choice is inherited again.

members.member: Whether to emit incremental visible and reasoning text signals. The terminal completion still carries the full output. This flag is not an optional generation default.

Maximum generated tokens, including reasoning. Select [code]-1[/code] to remove the cap, or [code]0[/code] to finish immediately with empty output. Clearing the choice restores inherited defaults; it does not select zero.
Sampling temperature. Lower values favor more likely tokens; zero requests greedy sampling where supported. Must be finite and fit a 32-bit float. The provider validates its supported range.
Number of highest-scoring token candidates retained for sampling. The provider defines the supported range and disabling value. Must fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Cumulative probability threshold for nucleus sampling. The provider validates the supported range. Must be finite and fit a 32-bit float.
Nonnegative random seed. A provider rejects values outside its supported range rather than truncating them. Clear the choice to inherit defaults; a selected zero is a real seed.

Token-score adjustment proportional to prior occurrence count. Positive values discourage repetition, negative values encourage it, and zero disables the adjustment. Must be finite and fit a 32-bit float.

Token-score adjustment applied once to tokens that have already appeared. Positive values discourage repetition, negative values encourage it, and zero disables the adjustment. Must be finite and fit a 32-bit float.

Text markers that end generation. A matched marker is withheld from visible output. Markers apply only to the content channel, not reasoning. Selecting an empty array disables inherited stop markers; clearing the choice restores inheritance.
Whether reasoning output is exposed separately from visible content. Provider support and model behavior determine availability. Reasoning tokens still count toward [member ChorusRequest.max_tokens].

Read-only syntax of the selected output constraint. Meaningful only when [method ChorusRequest.has_constraint] is true and [method ChorusRequest.is_unconstrained] is false. Change it with [method ChorusRequest.set_constraint].
Read-only source of the selected output constraint. Meaningful only for an explicitly selected constraint, not inherited defaults or explicit unconstrained output.

Provider-specific generation choices grouped by namespace, for example [code]{"llama": {"repeat_penalty": 1.1}}[/code]. Request values override matching project choices by key. Unknown namespaces, unsupported keys and invalid values are errors. Removing a request key restores inheritance rather than disabling a project choice.
Ephemeral messages for this sessioned request. They do not change stored history. Stateless requests reject injections. See [ChorusInjectedMessage] for placement rules.

Explicit chat template for a sessioned request. An explicitly selected empty string is invalid; use [method ChorusRequest.clear_chat_template] to inherit defaults. Stateless requests reject an explicit chat template.
